Fixed the CRM build failure in `751f0bb`. Root cause: the `summary` field used `{ type: 'sum', label: 'Total' }` object format, but `@objectstack/spec`'s `ListColumn` type only accepts string enum (`'sum' | 'avg' | ...`). Also added `as const` on `type` literals (e.g., `type: 'currency' as const`) to match the pattern used in `product.view.ts` and prevent TypeScript union widening.

The remaining errors in the CI logs (`@object-ui/plugin-designer` missing `@object-ui/react` module, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` failing to resolve `@object-ui/mobile`, `server.ts` Logger type) are all pre-existing on the base branch before this PR.
